note: Set A generally keeps values attached to the correct member types and section designations (C3X6 channel, W10X15/W10X12 beams, L4X4X5/16 and L3X3X1/4 angles, PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2, HSS 4X4X1/4 with its keynote), with quotes that match the text layer. Set B invents properties and conditions not on the sheet — 'framing spacing' of 11 1/2" and 6", duct-opening 'clearance' of 5/8" 'bottom' and 1 3/8" 'right side', and 10" called the depth of a C3X6 (a 3-inch channel) — plus several redundant C3X6 and 1/4" repeats. Set A's weaknesses are vaguer entities ('structural element', 'Duct Framing Detail') and two misbindings: PL5X3/8 attributed to 'component B' (a detail bubble) and L4X4X5/16 called a roof framing member when it appears in the duct/floor framing details. Overall A is the more faithful set.
